metadata.source: Oz Lit Teacher — Recommended Mentor Texts by Year Level and Genre
notes: Pink highlight in source PDF = book first introduced at that year level (introduced_at field).
year_levels = all year levels the book is recommended for, not just introduction year.
S&S column split into both summarising AND synthesising.
Books appearing in multiple genres at same year level get separate slug entries with genre suffix.
Same-title disambiguation by author name in slug (e.g. stuck_charlotte_calder vs stuck_oliver_jeffers).
touch_the_moon_phil_cummings: appears as narrative at Y3 but recount at Y4+ — year_levels merged under narrative entry.
the_all_new_must_have_orange_430: introduced Y4, extends to Y6 only (not Y5 — confirmed absent from Y5 persuasive section).
